candidates.sql: SELECT id, read_at_ms, score_components, score, grade, seated, cut_reason, threshold FROM candidate_pool ORDER BY id

candidate_summary.sql: SELECT count(*) n,count(distinct read_at_ms) reads,sum(score_components='{}') empty_components,sum(seated=0) cut,sum(seated=0 AND score=0) zero_cut,min(id) min_id,max(id) max_id FROM candidate_pool

cuts.sql: SELECT cut_reason,count(*) n,group_concat(id) ids FROM candidate_pool WHERE seated=0 GROUP BY cut_reason

planner.sql: SELECT id,version,bias_ai,bias_tree,bias_regime,tokens_in,prompt_hash,created_at FROM planner_read_facts ORDER BY id

planner_summary.sql: SELECT count(*) n,min(id) min_id,max(id) max_id,sum(version=0) version_zero,sum(tokens_in=0) tokens_zero,sum(COALESCE(bias_ai,'')='') bias_ai_empty,sum(COALESCE(bias_tree,'')='') bias_tree_empty FROM planner_read_facts

ordinal_summary.sql: SELECT count(*) n,min(id) min_id,max(id) max_id,sum(ordinal=1) ordinal_one FROM touch_outcomes

ordinal_validity.sql: SELECT validity,count(*) n,sum(ordinal=1) ordinal_one FROM touch_outcomes GROUP BY validity

ordinal_rows.sql: SELECT id,plan_id,plan_version,level_price,level_kind,ordinal,formed_at_ms,opened_at_ms,closed_at_ms,validity FROM touch_outcomes ORDER BY id
